title: Statement Credit Earned on Merchandise Spend under the Northbeam Credit Products
content:
Statement credit on an account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range is earned on merchandise spend at the percentage the product sets, and not more in a year than the product's yearly cap.

| Product | Statement credit earned on merchandise spend | Most statement credit that may be earned in a year |
|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 0.0 per cent | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 1.0 per cent | 250.00 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 3.0 per cent | 1500.00 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 0.0 per cent | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 0.0 per cent | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 1.5 per cent | 5000.00 |

Cap figures are US dollars and are read over a year.

## Worked figures on hypothetical spend

Merchandise spend of 400.00 US dollars, taken as a hypothetical amount, earns statement credit of 12.00 at the 3.0 per cent of the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card, 4.00 at the 1.0 per cent of the Northbeam Store Card Plus and 6.00 at the 1.5 per cent of the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit. The spend figure is hypothetical; the percentages are the products' own.

## Reading the cap

The cap is the most statement credit that may be earned in a year, so on the Northbeam Store Card Plus nothing beyond 250.00 is earned within one year however much is spent, and on the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card nothing beyond 1500.00.

Three products in the range, the Northbeam Store Card, the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account and the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account, earn at 0.0 per cent with a cap of 0.00, so no statement credit is earned on merchandise spend on those three.
